text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm… is this your current practice plan? 
… I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't play games with me. This 
isn't a real plan, is it?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I mean you, trainer. You're still hiding 
some grand self-sacrificial plan aren't 
you…!?
